description:
Title: Full Stack Developer
 



 Location: Pune
 



 Exp: 3 \- 5 Years
 



 Timing: 3pm \-11pm \| Monday to Saturday (2nd \& 4th Saturday Off)
 



 Joining: Immediate
 



 Website: https://chatwithads.com/
 



 Address: NIBM road, Pune
 



  





 ChatwithAds is building an AI\-powered intelligence layer for paid media teams—helping brands move from
 **Signal → Decision → Outcome → Learning** 
 .
 



 We’re looking for a strong product engineer who doesn’t just ask, “What should I build?” but thinks ahead:
 



**What are we really trying to solve? What will this need to become six months from now? How do we build it fast today without creating problems tomorrow?** 




 This is an
 **onsite role in Pune** 
 . You’ll work closely with the founder and product team, with significant ownership over how the product gets built.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Build and ship core CWA product features across frontend, backend, APIs, data and AI workflows.
* Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction.
* Convert rough product ideas into thoughtful, scalable implementations.
* Build systems around advertising data, analytics, signals, recommendations and decision tracking.
* Design integrations with platforms such as Google Ads, Meta, Slack, Teams, email, ClickUp/Asana and other business tools.
* Work with LLMs, agents, structured outputs, retrieval and AI\-assisted workflows.
* Think through architecture, edge cases, data quality, permissions, performance and reliability.
* Identify technical problems before they become bottlenecks.
* Turn repeated workflows into reusable systems instead of repeatedly patching features.
* Use modern AI development tools to improve development speed.
* Own features from idea → architecture → implementation → deployment → monitoring.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 You should be someone who:
 


* Has strong full\-stack development fundamentals.
* Can independently understand a business problem and propose the technical solution.
* Thinks beyond the immediate ticket.
* Understands APIs, databases, backend architecture and modern frontend development.
* Is comfortable working with large amounts of third\-party data.
* Has experience building SaaS products.
* Understands or is excited to deeply learn AI/LLM application development.
* Can move quickly without writing disposable code.
* Knows when to engineer for scale and when to keep things simple.
* Communicates clearly about technical trade\-offs.
* Is naturally curious about new technologies and constantly experiments with better ways to build.



**The Mindset We Care About** 




 A normal developer says:
 



**“Tell me exactly what needs to be built.”** 




 A strong developer says:
 



**“I understand what you want. Here’s how I would build it.”** 




 The person we want says:
 



**“I understand what you’re trying to achieve. Here’s how I’d build it now, what will become difficult later, and how we can structure it today so we preserve our options without overengineering.”**




**You'll Fit Well If** 



* You want to work onsite and collaborate closely with the founding team.
* You enjoy ambiguous problems.
* You want influence over the product, not just implementation.
* You think in systems.
* You challenge weak assumptions.
* You care about product outcomes as much as code quality.
* You want to build something from an early stage into a serious technology company.



**Bonus**




 Experience with any of the following is valuable:
 


* Google Ads / Meta APIs
* Advertising technology or analytics platforms
* OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini APIs
* Agentic AI systems
* Python
* Node.js / TypeScript
* React / Next.js
* PostgreSQL
* Data pipelines
* AWS / GCP
* Queueing / background jobs
* Observability and monitoring
* Multi\-tenant SaaS architecture



  





**Growth**




 This is not intended to remain a narrow developer role.
 



 For the right person, there is significant room to grow into a
 **Lead Engineer / Engineering Lead / Head of Engineering** 
 position as CWA scales.
 



 We care more about
 **ownership, product thinking, technical judgment and rate of learning** 
 than titles.

title: Implementation Engineer III
description:
OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Implementation Engineer III is a senior technical delivery leader who partners with government customers to bring OpenGov cloud software to life, owning the most complex product configurations and the underlying data migrations across a portfolio of implementations. This role leads requirements validation, configuration and data reviews, platform configuration and testing, data migration and reconciliation, and user enablement, guiding customers through the full deployment journey from kickoff to go\-live while setting the technical quality bar for the team.
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor with deep product knowledge and advanced data and database expertise, the Implementation Engineer III understands each customer's goals, pain points, and workflows, and translates them into scalable, maintainable solutions. This role blends hands\-on technical delivery, including data transformation and migration (ETL), and scripting, with a consultative, customer\-first approach. It also mentors less\-experienced engineers, reviews their configuration and data work, and drives the process and quality improvements that raise the standard of implementation delivery across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead the data migration, configuration, and testing of OpenGov cloud software for the most complex government implementations across the United States
* Perform configuration reviews across the team, validating that platform setup aligns with documented requirements, product best practices, and long\-term maintainability before go\-live
* Perform data reviews, validating migrated data for completeness, accuracy, and integrity, and reconciling source\-to\-target data so the product reflects trusted, audit\-ready customer data
* Own complex customer data migration end to end, including database schema mapping, ETL tool configuration, and advanced scripting, to ensure the product is populated with accurate, validated data
* Confirm and pressure\-test customer requirements across both configuration and data, resolving ambiguity and advising customers on the optimal solution design
* Design and execute comprehensive test scenarios that validate the configuration and migrated data produce accurate, expected outcomes prior to go\-live
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for government / customer stakeholder like Budget Directors, IT personnel, and decision\-makers, guiding them through the deployment and integration process
* Identify recurring customer pain points and partner with cross\-functional teams to simplify, enhance, and automate processes that improve customer workflows and delivery efficiency
* Mentor and coach Associate and mid\-level Implementation Engineers, reviewing their configuration and data work and helping accelerate their technical growth
* Define and improve implementation standards, templates, playbooks, and reusable tooling that increase the quality, consistency, and speed of delivery
* Partner closely with the Project Management, Customer Success Management, Data/Integration, and Product teams to ensure a consistent customer experience, and channel field feedback into the product roadmap


**Requirements And Preferred Experience**
* 6 to 9 years of experience in software implementation, data migration, or technical consulting, ideally with enterprise or SaaS products
* 5\+ years of hands\-on SQL scripting experience, including complex queries, data transformation, and reconciliation
* 3\+ years of Python, or similar, scripting experience for automation and data processing
* Deep experience with database technologies and with ETL and data\-migration concepts and tools, including schema design and performance considerations
* Experience implementing AI\-driven solutions for automation, workflow optimization, and data\-driven insights, leveraging modern frameworks and AI models
* Demonstrated ability to deliver complex implementations end to end and to mentor or provide technical guidance to less\-experienced engineers
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills, with a strong teamwork and customer\-service mentality across executive and technical stakeholders
* Strong attention to detail, with the proven ability to validate, reconcile, and sign off on data and configuration for accuracy
* Ability to adapt to a rapidly changing product and respond strategically to evolving customer needs
* Bachelor's degree in a technical, or related field


**Why OpenGov?**
**A Mission That Matters.**
 At OpenGov, public service is personal. We are passionate about our mission to power more effective and accountable government. Government that operates efficiently, adapts to change, and strengthens public trust. Some people say this is boring. We think it’s the core of our democracy.
   

  

**Opportunity to Innovate**
 The next great wave of innovation is unfolding with AI, and it will impact everything—from the way we work to the way governments interact with their residents. Join a trusted team with the passion, technology, and expertise to drive innovation and bring AI to local government. We’ve touched 2,000 communities so far, and we’re just getting started.
   

  

**A Team of Passionate, Driven People**
 This isn’t your typical 9\-to\-5 job; we operate in a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where impact matters more than simply clocking in and out. Our global team of 800\+ employees is united in our commitment to challenge the status quo. OpenGov is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Atlanta, Boston, Chicago, Dubuque, Dallas, and Pune.
   

  

**A Place to Make Your Mark**
 We pride ourselves on our performance\-based culture, where every employee is encouraged to jump in head\-first and take action to help us improve. If you have a great idea, we want to hear it. Excellent performance is recognized and rewarded, and we love to promote from within.
   

  

**Benefits That Work For You**
 Enjoy an award\-winning workplace with the benefits to match, including:
   

  

* Comprehensive healthcare options for individuals and families
* Flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid parental leave, wellness stipends, and HSA contributions
* Professional development and growth opportunities
* A collaborative office environment with weekly catered lunches.

title: Principal Application Engineer
description:
****Who is Litmus****
 Litmus is building the data foundation that powers industrial AI.
   

  

 AI doesn’t work without real\-world, contextualized data \- Litmus makes that data usable. As AI adoption accelerates, most industrial environments still can’t access or use their operational data. We solve that gap.
   

  

 We’re a growth\-stage software company helping manufacturers access, structure, and use real\-time data from machines, systems, and sensors at the edge. Our platform sits at the intersection of edge computing, AI, and industrial operations, enabling some of the world’s largest companies to run operations in real time, reduce downtime, and optimize production.
   

  

 Backed by leading investors and trusted by global manufacturers and partners like Google, Microsoft, Dell, Oracle, and Mitsubishi, Litmus is powering the shift toward software\-defined manufacturing.
   

  

****Why join Litmus****
****Build the infrastructure that makes industrial AI possible****
 AI is moving beyond the cloud and into the physical world. At Litmus, you’ll build the infrastructure that enables real\-time data to power AI and machine learning systems in production environments.
   

  

****Work on problems where software meets the real world****
 Most AI systems fail without access to real\-world data. You’ll build the layer that makes them viable in production. We solve challenges at the intersection of distributed systems, real\-time data, and industrial constraints — where reliability, scale, and performance are non\-negotiable.
   

  

****Have real impact, fast****
 You’ll work on systems used by real customers in production, with direct impact on product and company trajectory. As a scaling company, we move quickly. You’ll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to shape both product and company as we scale.
   

  

****Join a high\-performance team****
 We’re building a team that holds a high bar and pushes each other to improve. You’ll work alongside experienced operators, engineers, and leaders who have done this before and are building again at scale. We hire people who take ownership, move quickly, and care about outcomes. No passengers.
   

  

****Our culture****
 At Litmus, the team is collaborative, curious, and low ego. People are scrappy, take ownership, and look for ways to make an impact. We value empathy just as much as execution, whether that’s in how we build, how we communicate, or how we support each other.
   

  

 We’re a growing company, so things move quickly and not everything is perfectly defined. If you enjoy figuring things out, working closely with others, and making steady progress, you’ll do well here.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Principal Application Engineer is the senior technical authority within the Litmus Customer Success team for the APAC region. This role provides technical leadership, oversight, and direction to the regional Application Engineering team, ensuring that customer implementations of Litmus Edge and Litmus Edge Manager are architecturally sound, delivered consistently, and aligned with customer outcomes and Litmus best practices.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will oversee the technical work of Application Engineers supporting proof\-of\-concept projects, pilots, production implementations, customer expansions, and complex support engagements. This person will establish regional technical priorities, review and approve solution designs, guide application engineers through complex technical decisions, and ensure that contracted technical responsibilities are delivered successfully.
   

  

 As a senior individual contributor and regional technical leader, the Principal Application Engineer will act as the escalation point for high\-risk implementations, critical customer issues, and complex architectural decisions. The role will also mentor Application Engineers, improve delivery standards, and develop reusable technical approaches that increase the quality, predictability, and scalability of customer delivery across APAC.
   

  

 The Principal Application Engineer will partner closely with Customer Success leadership, Sales Engineers, Account Managers, Product Management, Development, partners, and the Litmus Support Desk. This role reports to the Manager, Customer Success Operations, with global reporting and technical alignment to the Director of Technical Delivery.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Serve as the senior technical authority for Customer Success application engineering activities across the APAC region and provide technical direction, guidance, standards adherence and oversight to Application Engineers.
* Establish technical priorities for the regional Application Engineering team in alignment with customer commitments, commercial objectives, available capacity, implementation risk, and business value.
* Work with Customer Success leadership to assign technical resources and determine the appropriate level of engineering support for customer engagements.
* Balance immediate customer requirements with long\-term maintainability, product strategy, delivery scalability, and Litmus technical standards.
* Ensure that technical solutions demonstrate measurable business value and support customers’ operational, manufacturing, data, automation, and digital transformation objectives.
* Identify implementation dependencies, assumptions, risks, and technical gaps early in the customer lifecycle.
* Support Application Engineers during customer meetings when senior technical leadership, architecture expertise, or escalation management is required.
* Maintain consistency in how Litmus products are designed, configured, deployed, tested, and supported across the APAC region.
* Define when technical exceptions may be approved and document the risks, conditions, and mitigation requirements associated with those exceptions.
* Onboard, mentor and coach Application Engineers, helping them strengthen their architecture, implementation, troubleshooting, customer communication, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Serve as the regional escalation point for complex implementation issues, critical customer incidents, architecture concerns, and unresolved Level 2 support cases and provide advanced troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and remediation guidance for issues involving Litmus products, customer infrastructure, networks, integrations, data flows, and industrial systems.
* Support Sales Engineers and Account Executives with architecture reviews, technical strategy, proposal development, scope validation, and implementation risk assessment.
* Provide senior technical oversight during the transition from pre\-sales to implementation.


****What You’ll Bring****
**Must Have**
* 10–15 years of progressive experience in application engineering, solution architecture, systems integration, technical consulting, customer success engineering, industrial technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Significant experience leading complex software, infrastructure, automation, IIoT, analytics, edge\-computing, or shop\-floor implementations in manufacturing or industrial environments.
* Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, architecture oversight, design approval, and implementation governance across multiple simultaneous customer engagements.
* Experience directing or overseeing the work of engineers, including setting technical priorities, reviewing deliverables, mentoring team members, and making technical decisions.
* Strong understanding of industrial and enterprise solution architecture, including networks, security, protocols, Linux\-based systems, databases, APIs, data pipelines, and distributed deployment environments.
* Deep hands\-on experience with product configuration, systems integration, technical troubleshooting, performance analysis, root\-cause analysis, and production support.
* Strong customer\-facing skills, including the ability to lead architecture workshops, explain complex technical concepts, manage technical objections, and communicate risk clearly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, engineers, sales teams, partners, product leaders, and executives.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance customer urgency, contractual commitments, technical risk, team capacity, and strategic value.
* Ability to operate independently as a senior technical leader while collaborating effectively across regional and global teams.
* Willingness and ability to support customers and engineers across APAC time zones and to travel regionally when required.


**Nice to Have**
* Experience with Litmus Edge, Litmus Edge Manager, industrial data platforms, edge orchestration platforms, or similar technologies.
* Strong knowledge of industrial protocols and systems, including OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus, PLCs, SCADA, historians, MES, and industrial control environments.
* Experience designing highly available, secure, and scalable industrial edge architectures across multiple facilities or geographic regions.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced
 **Full Stack Developer with strong Python and Microsoft Azure expertise** 
 to join our engineering team building and scaling a
 **PCI DSS v4\.0–ready, microservices\-based order processing platform** 
 . This platform running on a secure, private\-network Azure architecture.
 



 You will work across the full stack — from API design and serverless compute to database design and CI/CD — building secure, cost\-efficient, and highly available services in a regulated, payment\-adjacent environment.
 



**What You'll Work On** 



* Design, build, and maintain
 **Python\-based microservices on Azure Functions** 
 (Python 3\.11/3\.12\) across domains such as order intake, customer management, catalog, orchestration, tax, payment/PCI, fulfillment, notifications, and support APIs.
* Build and secure APIs exposed through
 **Azure API Management (APIM)** 
 — including authentication, throttling, CORS, brand\-scoped RBAC, and correlation\-ID based tracing.
* Work within a
 **Private VNet architecture** 
 , integrating Function Apps, Private Endpoints, NSGs, and NAT Gateway–based outbound connectivity to third\-party partners (payment gateways, tax providers, OMS, email/mail services).
* Design and maintain schemas in a
 **shared Azure SQL Database** 
 using module\-owned table prefixes, optimizing for cost and performance at moderate transaction volume.
* Implement
 **secrets and credential management via Azure Key Vault** 
 using Managed Identity — ensuring no hardcoded credentials anywhere in the platform.
* Build
 **tokenized payment integrations** 
 (e.g., CyberSource/PayPal) ensuring PAN/CVV data never touches application code or storage — token\-only handling.
* Contribute to
 **PCI DSS v4\.0 compliance controls** 
 : network segmentation, encryption in transit/at rest, access logging, audit trails, and secure system design.
* Support
 **queue\- and timer\-triggered async processing** 
 (cron/orchestration patterns) for order lifecycle management with retry logic.
* Collaborate on
 **cost\-optimization decisions** 
 — right\-sizing Function plans (Elastic Premium), SQL tiers, and reserved capacity planning.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production systems using
 **Application Insights, Log Analytics, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud** 
 .
* Partner with stakeholders to translate deployment architecture and solution design into working, well\-tested code.



  





 Requirements
 



**What We're Looking For** 




**Required:** 



* 6–9 years of professional software development experience, with strong full\-stack capability.
* Deep hands\-on experience with
 **Python** 
 (3\.x) for backend/microservice development.
* Solid experience building and deploying on
 **Microsoft Azure** 
 , specifically:
* Azure Functions (serverless compute, VNet integration)
* Azure API Management
* Azure SQL Database
* Azure Key Vault \& Managed Identity
* Azure VNet, NSGs, Private Endpoints, NAT Gateway
* Experience designing
 **RESTful APIs** 
 and microservices architectures.
* Experience with
 **relational database design** 
 (schema design, query optimization, TDE/encryption\-at\-rest concepts).
* Understanding of
 **secure application design** 
 : secrets management, least\-privilege access, RBAC, TLS/encryption in transit.
* Familiarity with
 **asynchronous/queue\-based or timer\-based processing patterns** 
 .
* Experience integrating with
 **third\-party APIs** 
 (payment gateways, tax engines, OMS, email/notification providers, etc.).
* Working knowledge of
 **monitoring/observability tools** 
 (Application Insights, Log Analytics or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of
 **CI/CD pipelines** 
 and cloud deployment practices.



**Preferred / Nice to Have:** 



* Experience working in a
 **PCI DSS–regulated environment** 
 .
* Exposure to
 **e\-commerce order management systems** 
 (Shopify, OMS platforms, or similar).
* Experience with
 **tokenized payment processing** 
 (CyberSource, PayPal, Stripe, or similar gateways).
* Familiarity with
 **Infrastructure as Code** 
 (Bicep, ARM templates, or Terraform on Azure).
* Front\-end development experience (React/Angular/Vue) for full\-stack contributions beyond APIs.
* Experience with
 **cost optimization** 
 on cloud platforms (reserved capacity, right\-sizing).
* Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-204, AZ\-400, AZ\-305\) are a plus.



**Soft Skills** 



* Strong ownership mindset — comfortable working across the stack from database to API to deployment.
* Ability to work in a security\- and compliance\-conscious environment with attention to detail.
* Clear communicator, able to work with architects and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Comfortable in a fast\-paced environment balancing scalability, security, and cost.
